mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of broader economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly declines in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 3.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery (HOUST > 1200 thousand units) and rising consumer spending (RSAFS > 490000 million dollars), demand-driven economic acceleration boosts corporate profits and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: housing recovery and strong consumer spending
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 490000, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with a 6-month rising PAYEMS trend.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals weakening housing demand that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where HOUST < 1200 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals successful monetary tightening without recession, reducing equity risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls simultaneously, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply shocks (INDPRO < 100 index level), production constraints and potential inflationary pressures reduce corporate profit margins and increase equity risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where INDPRO < 100.
